page_title: AI Art: Free AI Art Generator & Community

sources.entry: NightCafe - A popular AI art platform that generates images from text prompts in multiple artistic styles. It offers daily free credits, community challenges, and style customization for creative projects. #freemium

summary.name: NightCafe
summary.one_liner: NightCafe is a web-based AI art generator and community where users create images and videos from text prompts using many AI models, and share work in daily challenges.
use_cases: Creating AI artwork from text prompts as a hobby
Generating character art or tattoo concepts
Making social media banners or covers
Sharing and discussing AI art with a community
summary.what_it_does: NightCafe lets users type a text prompt, pick an AI model, and generate an image or video, with results typically appearing in seconds. It offers many models in one place, including GPT, Nano Banana, Seedream, Grok, Flux and Ideogram, plus video models such as Runway, Kling and Seedance. Users can publish creations, like and comment on others' work, follow artists, and join chat rooms. The site runs a new themed daily AI art challenge that users enter and vote on. It also provides specialised generators for flags, characters, banners and tattoo designs. Free daily credits are provided, and creations are saved to the account across devices.
notable: Free daily credits with a free plan that gives access to a range of models
Daily themed AI art challenges with community voting
Large model selection including GPT, Nano Banana, Seedream, Grok, Flux and Ideogram
Community features: chat rooms, galleries, follows and Discord
caveats: PRO tier gives more credits and access to more powerful models
Copyright ownership of AI-generated art depends on jurisdiction and is still evolving, per the page
